reason: Root and a further independent review found the initial source did not reproduce all pre-existing peak algorithm requirements: it used smoothed-mean ptp for prominence rather than the original definition and omitted the original0.03THz peak-distance, uniform-axis validation and numerical prominence floor. The first review checked only the reduced metadata parameters and failed to detect these differences.
required_new_review: Direct reuse of experimental_peaks.analyze_source_peaks with FitScope
Exact pre-existing prominence base, distance0.03THz, uniform-axis validation and numerical floor
Pinned original experimental_peaks and leakage_guard hashes checked before and after execution
Real numpy/scipy synthetic regression tests comparing unchanged original helper outputs
TRAIN-only access and role/identity hash boundaries still hold
Old mixed-model descriptive score scope remains explicit; no pure-species retraining claim
